authority: Research consolidation only. docs/canonical/** remains the normative source; this file cannot resolve open decisions or approve production use.
rules: private_capture=true entries are NOT_INDEPENDENTLY_AUDITED: raw bytes are outside Git and reviewers can only check sanitized summaries.
Fingerprints derived from private captures inherit NOT_INDEPENDENTLY_AUDITED.
git_sha values are 40-hex; sha256 values are 64-hex. Digest basis for public files is the raw git blob served by raw.githubusercontent.com.
Failures and drops are preserved; a later success never erases an earlier failure.

committed_sanitized_artifact_digests.basis: sha256 of git blob bytes at 8673ca8 (LF). The 2026-11-17 protocol-evidence.json recorded afc96093... for protocol-capability-registry.json, which is the Windows autocrlf working-tree digest, not the blob digest.
